with raw_archive as (
    

    -- Non-NOMIS tables or where target is not prod or prod_dev 
    -- just select all rows, filtered to those newer than the max _timestamp already loaded on incremental runs.
    select *
    from "awsdatacatalog"."raw_archive"."activities_daily_statistics"
)

select *
from raw_archive

-- Full Refresh Logic on deduped data
WITH

casted_timestamps AS (

    SELECT "id","sentence_plan_id","area_of_need","target_date","status",cast("status_date" as TIMESTAMP(6)) as "status_date","created_by_user_id",cast("created_at" as TIMESTAMP(6)) as "created_at",cast("updated_at" as TIMESTAMP(6)) as "updated_at","goal_order","updated_by_user_id","title_length","title_hash","op","checkpoint_col","__source_primary_key_hash","__surrogate_key_hash"

,
        -- explicitly cast this column as it may not already be a timestamp
        CAST(_timestamp
         AS TIMESTAMP(6))
        AS _timestamp
    FROM "awsdatacatalog"."preprocessed_prisons_history_dev_dbt"."sentenceplanassessmentview_goal_deduped_view"

),

calculate_valid_to_default AS (

    SELECT *,
    CAST (TIMESTAMP '2250-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP(6))
    AS valid_to_default
    FROM casted_timestamps

),


apply_window AS (

    SELECT "id",
  "sentence_plan_id",
  "area_of_need",
  "target_date",
  "status",
  "status_date",
  "created_by_user_id",
  "created_at",
  "updated_at",
  "goal_order",
  "updated_by_user_id",
  "title_length",
  "title_hash",
  "op",
  "checkpoint_col",
  "__source_primary_key_hash",
  "__surrogate_key_hash",
        _timestamp,
        _timestamp AS __valid_from,
    
        CASE
            WHEN op = 'D' THEN _timestamp
            ELSE LEAD(_timestamp, 1, valid_to_default)
                OVER(PARTITION BY __source_primary_key_hash
                    ORDER BY _timestamp,checkpoint_col)
        END AS __valid_to
    
    FROM calculate_valid_to_default

),

flag_current_records AS (

    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN  TIMESTAMP '2250-01-01' < current_date THEN false
            WHEN __valid_to = TIMESTAMP '2250-01-01' THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS __current
    FROM apply_window

)



    SELECT *,
        __valid_from as mojap_start_datetime, __valid_to as mojap_end_datetime, __current as mojap_current_record
    FROM flag_current_records
